given: one or more stock records exist across one or more locations
when: a warehouse operator opens the home screen
then: a table is shown with one row per stock record, each row carrying that record's SKU, location, and quantity
architectural_notes: E2E: exercises the full path from persisted stock_records through the JSON boundary (app/routes) reading via stock-service (app/services) and stock-repository (app/repositories) into the React SPA home table (client/). No new server logic — the repository read and boundary shape land in the established layers; the boundary returns data (R5), never HTML, and the SPA renders one row per record. Cross-cutting: rendering/presentation owned by the client, ORM access confined to the repository. Verified via a real-branch integration test that seeds records and asserts the API response, plus a client component test asserting a row per record.
